 Here are the Predictions for Nepal Premier League 2026, 7th Match - Lumbini Lions vs Chitwan Rhinos and 8th Match - Sudurpaschim Royals vs Biratnagar Kings, to be played on the 31st of October at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur.
 Match Prediction - Lumbini Lions v Chitwan Rhinos 
 7th Match - Lumbini Lions vs Chitwan Rhinos (Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur) 
 Ground Stat:
 Average 1st Innings Total at Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur (Nepal Premier League) - 157 
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur (Nepal Premier League) - 137 
 Current Form Lumbini Lions:
 Lumbini Lions are currently placed at the 2nd position on points table with 1 win to their credit. 
 The top run scorer for Lumbini Lions in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is D'Arcy Short with 40 runs to his name. 
 The top wicket taker for Lumbini Lions in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Kishore Mahato with 4 scalps under his belt. 
 Lumbini Lions have won their previous match against Sudurpaschim Royals by 7 wickets.
 Sudurpaschim Royals batted first and they posted a total of 87 before being bowled out. Saif Zaib, Binod Bhandari and Aarif Sheikh all got out cheaply and Sudurpaschim Royals got off to the most horrible start. Brandon McMullen also got out cheaply. Dipendra Singh Airee tried to revive the innings with a knock of 27 runs but he kept losing partners in regular succession. Sudurpaschim Royals could never gain momentum into the innings and they were eventually bowled out for just 87.
 During the chase, Lumbini Lions started off very well. Openers D'Arcy Short and Aasif Sheikh were really calculative in their shot selection. Short made 40 runs off 18 balls while Sheikh scored 32 runs in 25 deliveries to seal the deal in favor of Lumbini Lions. They chased the target quite comfortably in the 10th over itself with 7 wickets in hand.
 Current Form Chitwan Rhinos:
 Chitwan Rhinos are currently placed at the 3rd position on points table with 1 win to their credit. 
 The top run scorer for Chitwan Rhinos in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Dawid Malan with 70 runs to his name. 
 The top wicket taker for Chitwan Rhinos in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Kamal Singh Airee with 4 scalps under his belt. 
 Chitwan Rhinos have won their previous match against Biratnagar Kings by 8 runs.
 Chitwan Rhinos batted first and they posted a total of 157 for 3 in 20 overs. Dev Khanal and Dawid Malan started off very well for Chitwan Rhinos. Malan was the aggressor in the partnership. They collected 58 runs for the 1st wicket partnership. Khanal made 12 while Malan went on to score 70 runs in only 50 balls, hitting 5 fours and 5 sixes. Ravi Bopara and Dan Mousley also contributed healthily, scoring 31 and 29 runs respectively to help Chitwan Rhinos get to 157 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Imran Sheikh and Lokesh Bam began very well. Sheikh made 39 runs while Bam scored 26 runs but both of them got out at a wrong time. After their dismissals, the middle order struggled a lot. Andre Russell smashed 33 off 17 balls but he also threw it away. The lower order failed to produce any impact and Biratnagar Kings were eventually bowled out for 149, losing the match by 8 runs.

 Match Prediction - Sudurpaschim Royals v Biratnagar Kings 
 8th Match - Sudurpaschim Royals vs Biratnagar Kings (Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur) 
 Ground Stat:
 Average 1st Innings Total at Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur (Nepal Premier League) - 157 
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur (Nepal Premier League) - 137 
 Current Form Biratnagar Kings:
 Biratnagar Kings are currently placed at the 6th position on points table with 2 losses to their credit. 
 The top run scorer for Biratnagar Kings in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Imran Sheikh with 39 runs to his name. 
 The top wicket taker for Biratnagar Kings in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Angelo Matthews with 1 scalp under his belt. 
 Biratnagar Kings have lost their previous match against Karnali Yaks by 4 wickets.
 Biratnagar Kings batted first and they posted a big total of 186 for 7 in 20 overs. Imran Sheikh, Charith Asalanka and Shehan Jayasuriya all got out without troubling the scorers much. After their dismissals, Lokesh Bam came into his own. He smashed the bowlers to all parts and made 87 runs off only 52 balls, collecting 3 fours and 9 sixes. Andre Russell also made a very valuable contribution of 27 runs in 15 balls towards the back end to propel Biratnagar Kings to a highly ompetitive total of 186 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Karnali Yaks lost their opener Mark Watt quite early. Ariful Islam played some good looking boundaries but he also threw it away after getting the start. Karnali Yaks were reduced to 57 for 5 in the 7th over itself and looked in all sorts of bother. After that phase, Sompal Kami and Gulshan Jha took it in their own hands to take Karnali Yaks home. Jha made 28 off 21 balls while Kami smashed 62 runs in only 32 deliveries. Both stayed not out and won the game for Biratnagar Kings in the last over with 4 wickets in hand.
 Current Form Sudurpaschim Royals:
 Sudurpaschim Royals are currently placed at the 5th position on points table with 1 win and 1 loss to their credit. 
 The top run scorer for Sudurpaschim Royals in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Dipendra Singh Airee with 78 runs to his name. 
 The top wicket taker for Sudurpaschim Royals in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Anil Kharel with 5 scalps under his belt. 
 Sudurpaschim Royals have won their previous match against Pokhara Avengers by 6 wickets.
 Pokhara Avengers batted first and they posted a total of 145 for 7 in 20 overs. Dinesh Kharel got out quite cheaply. After his dismissal, Mahedi Hasan and Kushal Bhurtel tried to revive the innings with a stand of 35 runs for the 2nd wicket. Once these two got out though, the scoring rate slowed down and Pokhara Avengers looked out of place. It was Bibek Magar, who scored 40 important runs in the lower order to help Pokhara Avengers get past the 140 run mark, finishing at 145 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Sudurpaschim Royals also got off to a terrible start, losing the wickets of Saif Zaib and Binod Bhandari quite early. After that phase, Dipendra Singh Airee stepped up for his team. He smashed 51 runs in only 36 balls, hitting 4 fours and 2 sixes. Ishan Pandey also contributed quite well and made 37 runs and Sudurpaschim Royals comfortably chased the target down in the 17th over itself with 6 wickets in hand.
